verdict.rationale: Supabase ships a dashboard AI Assistant, so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question, but no evidence shows it doing so. The evidence covers the server side instead: an official Supabase MCP server for outside agents, plus a guide to building and hosting your own MCP servers on Edge Functions. Those are a different role and a developer building block, so they earn no credit for MCP-client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
